newsitem.title: TURKEY: Iraq's Aziz arrives in Turkey for talks.
newsitem.headline: Iraq's Aziz arrives in Turkey for talks.

text.p: Iraq's Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz arrived on an impromptu visit to the Turkish capital on Tuesday for talks with senior officials.
Turkish officials said Aziz, who flew to Ankara from Moscow, will meet Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan at 3.00 p.m. (1300 GMT).
He will also hold talks with Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller when she returns from a visit to Jordan, Turkey's foreign ministry said.
Aziz is expected to leave Ankara on Wednesday morning, the state-run Anatolian news agency said.
His visit to Russia was seen by diplomats in Baghdad as part of Iraq's efforts to rally support for an early implementation of a delayed oil-for-food deal signed by Baghdad and the United Nations.
In Moscow, Aziz met with Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov, who told a news conference he supported Iraq's call for quick implementation of the oil deal.
The accord would allow Baghdad oil sales worth $2 billion every six months to buy food and medicine for Iraqis, suffering from stringent U.N. sanctions imposed for Iraq's 1990 invasion of Kuwait.
